reason: The 12.4155 A F-centered cell, Z=16, and the submitted average framework are strongly supported by the peak positions and extracted intensity ratios, and an F23 refinement approaching special coordinates gives some support for F-43m. Exact recovery is not sufficiently established, however: the comparable whole-pattern report is unavailable, the trace's final ad hoc profile fit still has RMSE 0.6358 (about 0.196 unweighted relative residual; the preceding reported Rw-like value was 0.235), and its Cu-Kalpha2 fraction is pinned at a bound despite the specified Cu Kalpha1 pattern. Only a restricted set of F23 Wyckoff realizations was taken through whole-profile refinement, with no uncertainty test against lower-symmetry or alternative element-order models. This matters because the submitted ordering gives Sr-S contacts shorter than Zn-S contacts (about 2.59 versus 2.69-2.80 A), making a chemically motivated ordering alternative worth explicit full-profile comparison. Another attempt is warranted to obtain a comparable fit and determine whether the submitted symmetry, coordinates, and Sr/Zn ordering are unique rather than merely a good average-framework realization.
